items.title: Upload Your RAM
items.summary: A satirical site offering to let you 'donate' the idle RAM sitting in your computer to a better cause, riffing on the idea that buying more memory is wasteful. Selecting an amount like 2 GB or 4 GB kicks off a mock upload of that memory.

items.title: Libghostty 1.0
items.summary: Mitchell Hashimoto announced the 1.0 release of libghostty, a portable high-performance C library for terminal emulation extracted from the core of the Ghostty terminal. The 1.0 milestone marks both the library and its C ABI as stable, with the C API now running in production across hundreds of products.

items.title: Need for Speed Underground 2 online in the browser
items.summary: A fan project (nfsu2-web) has recompiled the PC version of Need for Speed Underground 2 to run the game's own code in the browser, letting you play it online without installing anything. The project is unaffiliated with EA and hosts free-roam multiplayer sessions.
